challengeSolutions.Reaching younger audiences: TikTok is THE platform to reach Gen Z and Millennials, with 60% of users aged 16-24.
challengeSolutions.Creative fatigue: TikTok's native, authentic content style combats creative fatigue with fresh, engaging formats.
challengeSolutions.Rising CPMs: TikTok offers competitive CPMs with strong performance, helping optimize your media efficiency.
challengeSolutions.Limited reach: With 1B+ monthly active users, TikTok provides massive incremental reach to complement existing channels.
challengeSolutions.Low engagement: TikTok users spend an average of 95 minutes per day on the app—the highest engagement of any platform.
challengeSolutions.Attribution issues: Our advanced measurement solutions including CAPI, Brand Lift, and Conversion Lift provide clear attribution.
challengeSolutions.Competition: Stand out from competitors by being an early mover on TikTok in your vertical.
challengeSolutions.Scaling issues: TikTok's diverse ad formats and broad reach enable efficient scaling of campaigns.
challengeSolutions.Brand perception: Build authentic connections with audiences through native, creator-driven content.
challengeSolutions.New market entry: TikTok's global reach and cultural relevance make it ideal for market expansion.

scenarioMessages.New Product Launch: With a new product launch on the horizon, timing is critical to capture market attention.
scenarioMessages.Geo Expansion: As they expand into new geographic markets, reaching new audiences is essential.
scenarioMessages.Rebrand: With a rebrand underway, this is the perfect moment to reintroduce the brand to audiences.
scenarioMessages.Full Funnel: A full-funnel approach will maximize impact across awareness, consideration, and conversion.
scenarioMessages.Seasonal Campaign: Seasonal moments drive peak consumer intent—perfect timing to maximize TikTok's engaged audiences.
scenarioMessages.Always On: An always-on presence builds sustained brand awareness and keeps the brand top-of-mind.

universal: Hook viewers in the first 1-2 seconds with movement, text, or intrigue
Create native content that feels organic to TikTok, not like an ad
Use trending sounds strategically (check Commercial Music Library)
Keep videos between 9-15 seconds for optimal completion rates
Include clear CTAs but make them feel natural to the content
Test 3-5 creative concepts per ad group for variety
Refresh creative every 7-14 days to combat fatigue
Use text overlays - 40% of users watch with sound off
Feature real people over polished productions when possible
Engage with comments to boost organic visibility

E-commerce: Use Spark Ads to boost authentic creator content featuring products
Implement TikTok Shop for seamless in-app purchasing
Show products in action with quick, engaging demonstrations
Use urgency-driving hooks like 'limited time' or 'selling fast'
Test Collection Ads to showcase multiple products
Gaming: Feature actual gameplay footage in the first 3 seconds
Partner with gaming creators for authentic endorsements
Use Playable Ads for interactive game demos
Target by gaming interests and related game titles
Show game progression and rewards to drive installs
App: Demo the core app experience in under 15 seconds
Use screen recordings with engaging voiceovers
Highlight the immediate value/benefit users get
Test Playable Ads for interactive previews
Partner with creators who authentically use the app

Partner with finance creators for credibility
Focus on life improvements, not just features
Ensure compliance with financial advertising regulations

Partner with lifestyle creators for authentic content
Leverage seasonal moments and trending topics

Use POV and lifestyle content over traditional car ads
Show the driving experience, not just the vehicle
Target by life events (new job, family, etc.)
Travel: Partner with travel creators for authentic experiences
Show the feeling of being there, not just logistics
Use trending sounds and effects for discovery
Target by travel interests and intent signals
Entertainment: Tease content without giving too much away
Use clips that create FOMO or curiosity
Partner with entertainment creators for reactions
Leverage trending moments and cultural conversations
Tech: Show the product solving real problems
Use quick demos and feature highlights
Partner with tech reviewers and enthusiasts
Compare to alternatives in subtle ways
Food: Partner with food creators and home cooks
Leverage meal occasions and cultural moments
Beauty: Partner with beauty creators for tutorials
Use ASMR and satisfying application moments
Show real results from real people
Fashion: Show outfit transitions and styling tips
Use trending sounds for outfit reveals
Partner with fashion creators for OOTD content
Feature inclusive sizing and diverse models
Create shoppable looks with Collection Ads
Health: Focus on wellness journeys and transformations
Partner with fitness and health creators
Ensure compliance with health advertising regulations
Show real people achieving real results
Education: Partner with educator and expert creators
Show learning outcomes and success stories
Make complex topics accessible and engaging
Use trending formats for educational content

Use TopView for maximum impact during key moments

Set up CRM integration for immediate follow-up

Respond to comments to boost visibility
